description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the Order Published in Gaz. Exord. No. 1949/29 of 12.01.2016 by inserting item 1(d) in relavant to import motor vehicles by the M.Ps
categorisation: The gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It contains an order issued by the Minister of Finance that modifies the schedule of a previous gazette notification, specifically adding new items related to excise duty on motor vehicles imported under concessionary terms. While it mentions a government official (Ravi Karunanayake as Minister of Finance), the core content is about regulatory changes to tax legislation rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
